name: Sensorik Ammertal GmbH

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 13 of 23 invoices paid >3 days late, max 7 days. Avg 3.4 days late; 13 of 23 invoices >3 days late - an investor will notice.

financial_health.signal: Private, credit 176 unchanged; new financial investor owner since June 2026.

situation: Sensor maker (EUR 35 m), sole source of the 0-16 bar pressure sensor; frame ends 2026-12-31. A financial investor bought it in June 2026 and plans to review prices and terms with all customers. Sales says price reductions are frozen until December 2027 but is open on payment terms and call-off flexibility; its quote holds EUR 23.13 flat. Price is ~3% above should-cost (22.47).

pressures.evidence: Acquired by an investor that will review prices and terms.
Freeze on reductions; open on payment terms and call-off.

what_it_values: cash and margin for the new owner (EBITDA, working capital)

likely_tradeables.why: investor-owned: cash beats list price; sales open on payment

likely_tradeables.get: price hold before investor review bites

arguments_that_should_land.argument: Mean OTD 86.0% over the last four quarters (from 93.1%).

key_quotes.quote: The new owner plans to review prices and terms with all customers.
He was open on payment terms and call-off flexibility.
